_comment: Codex pre-tool hook for shell commands. Checked against codex-cli 0.166.0 (feature `hooks` is stable and on; the PreToolUse event exists in its schema). The file has the shape of ~/.codex/hooks.json. Merge the PreToolUse entry into that file by hand; the platform does not edit ~/.codex. Exit code 2 from the guard blocks the command, as in Claude Code. The matcher lists the shell tool names that Codex builds use. hooks/codex.rules stays as the second layer.
